acceptance.WG3-AC-09: pass — exact semicolon/full-stop/newline copies are approved; missing character, 350->3500, 两件装->三件装, negation flip/double negation, merged/split source boundaries and cross-sentence stitching are rejected; word-order/connective changes carry coverage_explanations and require independent reviewer approval.

ticket_items.1_exact_multi_sentence: pass — two punctuation/newline HTTP cases return 200 with an approved prompt_plan; the T87 H1 newline positive case remains green in the regression group.
ticket_items.2_anti_fake_pass: pass — missing character, numeric/quantity changes, negation changes, source-boundary merge/split and cross-sentence stitching all return 409 before review or image submission.
ticket_items.3_word_order_connective: pass — word-order and connective cases expose coverage_explanations on the output_reviewer input; reviewer pass projects approval, reviewer reject returns 409 PROMPT_REVIEW_REJECTED.
ticket_items.4_true_omission_vs_drift: pass — owned omission is REPAIRABLE_COMPOSITION with one auto repair, intent retained, budget 2 and one approved revision 2; owned numeric drift is TRUE_DRIFT with intent abandoned and no artifact.
ticket_items.5_http_end_to_end: pass — authenticated HTTP confirm_requirements -> candidate -> independent review -> S10 projection; assertions cover intent/usage/slots, RevisionBudget, artifacts and VisualStub submit_calls.
ticket_items.6_wg3_ac_09_evidence: pass — WG3-AC-09 is covered by the current HTTP suite; S07 still enforces budget, confirmation, size/reference hard bindings and reviewer evidence gates; no bypass path was added.
ticket_items.7_test_and_evidence_location: pass — tests are under backend/tests and evidence under docs/acceptance; no test scaffolding or evidence was written under main/.

public_errors: 409 PROMPT_REQUIRES_RECONFIRMATION and intent abandonment for dangerous drift
routing.retry_policy: one bounded auto repair only for intact coverage defects with an owned intent; no retry for missing characters, numeric/quantity changes, negation flips, boundary merges, cross-sentence stitching or reviewer rejection

known_red_note: The five entries are carried from T07 and were not rerun in T09; they are not caused by the T09 coverage changes and are not used as passing evidence.

approval_results.normal_path: exact, connective and word-order pass cases create one approved prompt_plan after output_reviewer pass
approval_results.repair_path: owned true omission creates no artifact for the first invalid candidate; the second candidate is approved at revision 2 after review
approval_results.true_drift: no prompt_plan artifact; latest GenerationIntent is abandoned, slots are released and no image is submitted
approval_results.reviewer_reject: word-order case with reviewer reject returns 409 PROMPT_REVIEW_REJECTED and creates no approved prompt

results.resources: temporary SQLite per case; counting LLMStub and VisualStub; no real network or image provider
results.artifacts: one approved prompt_plan in exact/connective/word-order-pass and true-omission cases; zero in all rejected and dangerous-drift cases

residual_unknowns: The full single-run pytest suite was not rerun; current evidence is the 15 T09 cases, 102 P1 cases, 34 core workflow cases and the 39-case focused regression group.
model_text=22 and image_generation=1 are counting-stub observations, not production token, latency, cost or provider measurements.
The independent reviewer is scripted in tests; real-model semantic judgment for word-order/connective cases is not measured here.
The connective whitelist is intentionally narrow (四周 / 保留); other natural-language connectives are conservatively rejected until separately evidenced.
Punctuation coverage exercises Chinese and ASCII semicolon/full-stop/newline variants, not every Unicode punctuation form.
T09 does not add a negative authorization test; all requests use the authenticated test client and existing T07/T40 confirmation gates remain in force.
integration/v3 advanced after the merge from b304649 to f782daf with only projects search/rename changes; ticket/95 was not merged again per lead instruction.
acceptance_notes: Docs and historical pass records are not used as current completion; the completion claim rests on the current HTTP T09 suite and the exact command outputs above. The red run is retained as defect evidence, and the full-suite absence is recorded as a residual unknown.
